params.body:
## What changed for the user

**Nieuwe locatie / Locatie aanpassen** (settings, Locaties pane, and the modal on the transport pane, which shares the partial):

- One card of reading width (720px, left-aligned) instead of every field across the full page with 60px between rows.
- Address as a compact grid: Straat wide with Nr. and Toevoeging beside it, Postcode narrow with Gemeente wide, then Land.
- A **Gebruik** section: the two switches are described toggle rows. Pick-up: where a buyer or the carrier collects a car (the location chosen as pick-up address on a car). Lever: where transport delivers (the location chosen as delivery address in a transport request). Meaning taken from the transport chapter, R S4-10.3.
- **Openingsuren** as one table: day, morning from-to, afternoon from-to, and a "gesloten" switch per half day in its own column (each with a unique id; before, both halves of a day shared `switch_monday`). Time fields are 44px. On a phone a day is a block with the two half days as labelled lines.
- Annuleren and Opslaan in `ui-form-actions` (Annuleren returns to the Locaties pane; in the modal it dismisses).
- "← overzicht" stands left of the title and links to `settings?tab=locations`; it no longer sits under the floating notification bell at 1440px.
- Field names, hidden-0-plus-checkbox-1 switches, the `opening_hours[day][half][i]` matrix, validation and the controller are untouched. Saved end-to-end locally: create, closed half day locked and persisted, edit, validation error shown under its field.

**Update aanpassen / Nieuwe update** (release notes):

- Same card (860px, the editor wants room). The four languages are an Alpine tab strip (Nederlands first) with Titel, Inhoud and Link per language as normal `ui-input`s. The 1.6rem bold `.input-title` is gone. A language with a server-side error opens first and its tab carries a dot; the client-side check no longer skips hidden panels and opens the panel of the first refused field.
- TinyMCE 5.10.9 stays self-hosted but configured: `menubar:false`, `branding:false`, `statusbar:false`, toolbar `undo redo | bold italic | bullist numlist | link | removeformat`, `paste_as_text:true`, `height:320`, `content_style` with Poppins. No `language:'nl'`: `public/js/tinymce/langs/` holds only a README, so the toolbar stays English.
- Saved end-to-end locally (four titles, editor content synced to the textarea).

**Settings, Back button.** `/settings` is a `Route::any`; a POST that landed there rendered the page as the answer to that POST, so Chrome's Back from Nieuwe locatie asked to resubmit a form (ERR_CACHE_MISS). `SettingsController::index` now answers any non-GET with a 302 to the same pane and re-flashes the session. Which POST put Shane there could not be reproduced locally (every save on the settings page already redirects, and the plain flow settings → Locaties → + → Back is three GETs); the door itself is now closed. The release-notes list has the same pattern (`Route::any('release_notes')` with a POST filter form), left as is.

## Docs

- Rules R P2-6.6 (location form) and R P2-10.20 (release-note form and the PRG on settings) in `32-p2-mijn-garage.md`.
- Finding `2026-09-15-locatieformulier-leest-niet-als-formulier.md` (opgelost).
- Open point `2026-09-15-tinymce-5-is-end-of-life.md`: TinyMCE 5 is end-of-life; an upgrade to 7 (self-hosted, licence and setting names change, a Dutch language pack) is a later item.
- Dead SCSS removed: the `#opening-hours` / `#locationModal` block in `_transport.scss`, `.input-title` in `_release_notes.scss`.

## Tests

New: `LocationFormTest` (card, grid, sections, all 28 time fields and 14 closed switches by name, edit values and readonly locking, back link left of the title, phone CSS), `ReleaseNoteFormTest` (four panels, TinyMCE settings, edit values, error opens its language), `SettingsPostRedirectsTest` (POST /settings is 302 not 200, tab kept, flash survives, GET still renders).

`vendor/bin/phpunit --filter 'Location|Settings|StylesheetSyntax|AlpineExpression|HandlerWiring|CompiledViews|RulesCoverage|RulesIdentity|ReleaseNote'`: OK (83 tests, 1080 assertions).

## Screenshots

Before/after at 1440 and 390 for create and edit of both forms in `.playwright-mcp/location-form/` of the worktree (`before-create-1440.png`, `after-create-1440.png`, `before-edit-390.png`, `after-edit-390.png`, `before-release-note-edit-1440.png`, `after-release-note-edit-1440.png`, ...).
params.title: The location form reads as a form
